about_the_game:
"Safe House" has an emphasis on resource management and strategic thinking. Every day, you will have to go out into the city to gather resources crucial for your survival. However, each new day presents a new challenge within the safe house itself. From the constant threat of gas leaks and the generator breaking down to raids on your safe house and unexpected radio contacts. "Safe House" demands strategic thinking and quick decision-making. Every choice has a consequence.

The goal? Survive until the military announces the evacuation plan on the radio. As you progress, you will have to make difficult choices that will ultimately affect the ending you get.

Key Features

  • Resource management: Gather and use your resources to upgrade the safe house and ensure your survival.

  • Dynamic events: Face many challenges, each requiring quick decision-making.

  • Adaptive Ending: Every choice affects your chances of survival and shapes the ending you get.

  • Featuring original music composed by Mike Hvll, who also contributed voice acting for one of the main characters.

content_descriptors.notes: This game has descriptions of various crimes and the utilization of guns in self-defense.
